thought.text: Server boots! But WorldTick still fails with API. Let me fix that too:

reasoning_content:
Good progress! Server now BOOTS (line: "Arelorian server listening on 3000"). But still fails in WorldTick at line ~1342 with `observedChunks.map is not a function`. Earlier I saw that the VPS WorldTick now has `.chunks` on the object - but my stubs were wrong. Let me also fix the WorldTick to use `observedChunks.chunks`.

This is actually good progress - server now gets to line 1342 instead of crashing on load!

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Fix observedChunks.map to observedChunks.chunks.map
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's/observedChunks.map/observedChunks.chunks.map/g' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Fixed map")

# Also fix the second usage  
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's/for (const chunkInfo of observedChunks)/for (const chunkInfo of observedChunks.chunks)/g' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Fixed for loop")

client.close()
EOF
